preconditions.expression: T == int(stdin.split()[0]) and T >= 1 and T <= 100
preconditions.description: The first line of input is a single integer T (1 ≤ T ≤ 100) representing the number of test cases.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 10**5 for N in [int(line) for line in stdin.split()[1::2]])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the first line after T is an integer N (1 ≤ N ≤ 10^5) representing the length of array A.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(num) <= 10**9 for num in [line.split()[1:] for line in stdin.split()[2::2]])
preconditions.description: For each test case, the second line contains N space-separated integers A_i (1 ≤ A_i ≤ 10^9).

postconditions.expression: all(len(output_line.split()) == N or output_line.strip() == '-1' for output_line, N in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [int(line) for line in stdin.split()[1::2]]))
postconditions.description: For each test case, the output is either a single line with N space-separated integers (a valid rearrangement of the input array) or '-1' if no valid rearrangement exists.

postconditions.expression: all(not any(all(A[i] >= A[i+1] for i in range(j, j + L - 1)) or all(A[i] <= A[i+1] for i in range(j, j + L - 1)) for L in range(3, N + 1) for j in range(N - L + 1)) if output_line.strip() != '-1' else True for output_line, N in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [int(line) for line in stdin.split()[1::2]]))
postconditions.description: For each test case where the output is not '-1', the output array A must satisfy the condition that no subarray of length ≥ 3 is non-increasing or non-decreasing.

postconditions.expression: all(set(output_line.split()) == set(input_array) if output_line.strip() != '-1' else True for output_line, input_array in zip(stdout.splitlines(), [line.split()[1:] for line in stdin.split()[2::2]]))
postconditions.description: For each test case where the output is not '-1', the output array must be a rearrangement of the input array.
